claim: A native single-agent writing run and Fable Workflow with Sonnet implementation and Opus review each produced a repair independently accepted by 29 visible and seven held-out checks. Actual model identities, usage, schema retry and scope deviations were retained.
limitations: One ordered local invoice fixture, not a fully compliant benchmark, upstream test suite or general model ranking.

Both model runs piped test output through tail, masking exit status; independent unpiped acceptance passed. The Workflow run did not invoke the required authoring skill and exceeded its literal read boundary by reading native metadata.

Single-agent usage was 194781 reported tokens and Workflow usage 753508. The native Workflow coordinator and workers are included; outer Codex preparation and coordination, independent audit and reporting are excluded. Native cache warmth was uncontrolled; these observations do not establish causal savings. Subscription billing is unknown.

independent_review.scope: Actual source changes, immutable inputs, unpiped 29 visible and seven hidden checks, model identities and native child usage reconciliation.
